snippet.title: Animula Nook | Gamescom 2026 Gameplay Trailer (4K) | Shrink at gamescom!
snippet.description:
“We are now arriving in Cologne. Thank you for travelling on Line 0826!”
⭐ Enjoying the ride so far? Add @Animula_Nook  to your Steam Wishlist! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3767320/Animula_Nook/
--
Hey, Wishweavers—good to see you again!

Line 0826 has arrived at Gamescom 2026, and we’re back with a fresh look at the latest development updates for @Animula_Nook .

Here’s what’s new in Minietopia:
📷 A brand-new Photo Mode
✨ Smoother movement
🌤️ Lively day-to-night changes
🏡 Fresher details across Minietopia
👗 More looks to make your own

Now, let’s shrink at Gamescom—together in Minietopia. Your next memory starts here.₍^˶ ╸𖥦 ╸˵^₎⟆✨

#ShrinkAtGamescom #AnimulaNook  #gamescom2026 #lifesim #cozygames 
--
📅 Gamescom 2026: Aug 26–Aug 30
🎪 Booth: Hall 08.1 | Space A-051-B-050
📍 Location: Koelnmesse, Cologne, Germany
--
🌐 Can’t make it to Cologne? Explore our virtual gamescom booth and enter for a chance to win 1 of 5 complete gamescom-exclusive merch bundles: https://animulanook.com/shrinkatgamescom/
🗓️ Virtual Booth X Giveaway: Aug 23–Aug 31, 12:00 PM (UTC+8)
👉 How to Join:
① Complete Fairytale Book – Minie Q&A.
② Generate your exclusive Q&A card.
③ Share it on X with #ShrinkAtGamescom #AnimulaNook #Gamescom2026.
④ Enter for a chance to win 1 of 5 complete gamescom-exclusive merch bundles!
--
As a thank-you for all your support, we’ve also teamed up with our Content Creators for 🎁extra giveaways on X and Discord🎁! Keep an eye out for gift cards, Discord gifts, and more!

👇 Follow our official channels for the latest giveaway updates:
🐦 X: https://x.com/Animula_Nook
🎮 Discord: https://discord.gg/animulanook
--
Please note: Animula Nook is currently in development. Content shown in this video does not represent the final quality of the game.
